items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I used to play in a brass band with him... And Sean Lee always was there, giving us ideas how to play. We used to rehearse at the... Scent of Sinners Club.

ctx.x: How did he teach you? I wondered what kind of...

He teach me out of a music book. A real music book. Not the regular music book then. But, he was teaching me out of a book he had around then. So, after I got to making my scales so good, so he recommended me to get a clarinet book. Oto Lange clarinet book. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. So, gee, I was playing up some music in that clarinet book. The scales, you know, chromatic scales, ascending and descending. I was doing all that. And then, I used to play in a brass band with him. He had a brass band. He had a son who…
Uh-huh. We used to rehearse there.
